author: Mark Atwood
text:
Session ending. Decomposed scope: this parent bead now covers canonical jmap-mail-server only (32 handle_* fns across 9 source files: email.rs, mailbox.rs, identity.rs, snippet.rs, vacation.rs, sieve.rs, submission.rs, thread.rs, mdn.rs). The 6 sibling-crate children (.30.1 through .30.6) cover the rest of the workspace propagation and are gated on canonical-first per the workspace propagation rule.

Implementation pattern fully demonstrated by commit 216cc61 (JMAP-h47t.17, tasks-server). Three changes per module:

1. Module-level '# Wire-shape contract' section explaining the RFC 8620 §5.x mapping for all handle_* in the module, when extra invocations are non-empty, and which JmapError variants surface.

2. Per-handler '`args` is the RFC 8620 §5.x request shape (...); the returned `Value` is the §5.x response shape (...)' paragraph naming required and optional fields.

3. Per-handler 'Returns (response_args, extra_invocations). The extra list is always empty.' trailer (mail-server already has this on most handlers; missing on the _changes ones).

Spec sections per handler kind: /get → RFC 8620 §5.1; /changes → §5.2; /set → §5.3; /copy → §5.4; /query → §5.5; /queryChanges → §5.6. Plus RFC 8621 §5-§7 for mail-specific shapes (Email/import, Email/parse, EmailSubmission/set, Mailbox shapes, etc.) and Sieve draft + MDN spec for the non-RFC-8621 mail extensions.

Releasing claim; the work itself is mechanical and well-scoped but volume exceeds this session budget.
